linear.definition: Length greater than three times width (L > 3W)
linear.acceptance_rule: Reject all relevant linear indications (must escalate to Level 2/3 inspector evaluation)

rounded.definition: Circular or elliptical shape with length equal to or less than three times width (L <= 3W)
rounded.acceptance_rule: Acceptable if relevant dimension <= 5.0 mm and not part of an aligned cluster

escalation_rules: Any relevant linear indication (crack, lack of fusion, or crack-suspect) is strictly NON-ACCEPTABLE and must escalate to inspector sign-off.
Any rounded indication with dimension > 5.0 mm is strictly NON-ACCEPTABLE.
Four or more relevant rounded indications in a line separated by 1.5 mm or less edge-to-edge are strictly NON-ACCEPTABLE.
Non-relevant indications (<= 1.5 mm) do not require repair unless verified as crack-suspect by the inspector.
